title: Egan Egana
lyrics:
Ta yad konian hardio armaan egan egana
Tharay goyan ma paza ma zan egan egana

Kos rakhmo e nazar bai manzil ma humsafar bai
Ma raz e zindagio tabir d mutabar bai
Ghaichan diti ganiman khoshpan egan egana
Tharay goyan ma paza ma zan egan egana

Ta budh koman khayala ta prushta awa boman
Dunyo awa raksuman tansar d juda boman
Ki ahi koman ta mokhtu ghaichan egan egana
Tharay goyan ma paza ma zan egana

Malagha nast hosgulo jaam o ougho ulaitam
Wabasta tasom har e yad o awa kruaitam
Palaitm ta anzairu khatan egan egana
Tharay goyan ma paza mazan egan egana

Sayed ghamo shilogho e khoshp joshi roksay na
Dunyo sari khoshtaway tu gham zuti hosay na
Tu det kya wakht hardio de fan egan egana
Tharay goyan ma paza ma zan egan egana
